story.titleZh: 新加坡与奥斯汀赛道间解锁性能，希望墨西哥站全力争胜
story.summaryZh: 哈斯车队在新加坡和奥斯汀两个截然不同的赛道上解锁了性能，希望在墨西哥站全力以赴。
story.originalTitle: "The fact that between Singapore and Austin, two very different circuits, we've unlocked performance – we’d like to build on that, and I hope we can...
story.summaryEn:
"The fact that between Singapore and Austin, two very different circuits, we've unlocked performance – we’d like to build on that, and I hope we can fight hard in Mexico.” 🗣️ AK
Finishing off race day in Austin with Ayao, Esteban and Ollie 🇺🇸
#HaasF1 #F1 #USGP
detailZh:
“在新加坡和奥斯汀这两个截然不同的赛道上，我们解锁了性能——我们希望在此基础上继续进步，并希望我们能在墨西哥站全力以赴。” 🗣️ AK
在奥斯汀站与阿亚奥、埃斯特班和奥利一起结束赛车日 🇺🇸
#哈斯F1 #一级方程式 #美国大奖赛
detailEn:
"The fact that between Singapore and Austin, two very different circuits, we've unlocked performance – we’d like to build on that, and I hope we can fight hard in Mexico.” 🗣️ AK
Finishing off race day in Austin with Ayao, Esteban and Ollie 🇺🇸
#HaasF1 #F1 #USGP

relatedItems.summaryEn:
"I think the baseline is good, and it’s now at the fine-tuning stage of understanding what we can do better on the medium and hard compounds, and at the same time, getting a bit more out of the soft tire." 🗣️ AK
Wrapping up Friday in São Paulo 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh:
“我认为基础线很好，现在正处于调整阶段，了解我们可以在中硬胎上做得更好的地方，同时，从软胎上得到更多。” 🗣️ AK
在圣保罗结束周五的比赛 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #巴西大奖赛
